gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-athiti: Athiti draws every line at a single width, with a see-through s. Delius Unicase answers with a relaxed, hand-lettered looseness, and that friendly handwriting against tidy sans lines is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-atkinson-hyperl: Delius Unicase writes loose and friendly, with stroke ends as wide as the middle. Atkinson Hyperlegible sits beneath it, sans and sturdy, its wide-set s terminals giving the handwriting something firm to lean on.
Strokes that hold one constant width from top to baseline give Delius Unicase its hand-lettered, easygoing face. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is the quiet partner, with stencil-wide spacing.

Delius Unicase is handwritten and relaxed, its strokes showing no modulation at all. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next feels contemporary beside it, with big open lowercase eyes that make the friendly heading seem even more casual.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-biryani: Delius Unicase has a loose, handwritten ease, its strokes never tapering where they end. Yet Biryani keeps things tidy beneath it, with large open eyes on every e and no thick-and-thin variation anywhere.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-blinker: Loose handwriting meets tidy lettering here, with Delius Unicase up top and Blinker below. And where the heading is best at being relaxed and inviting, Blinker is best at open, readable lowercase that fills most of its height.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic reads modern and businesslike, with a high-set x-height and generously opened curves. Delius Unicase does casual handwriting best, while Carrois Gothic does clear, orderly text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-carrois-gothic-: Delius Unicase writes with a relaxed hand and no modulation in its line. Carrois Gothic SC does the opposite job best, keeping capitals and lowercase close in height with clear openings at every curve.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code reads like fine wire, with generous gaps between neighbors and smooth, unobstructed bends. Over a full page it feels spacious and steady, a plain sans foil to the handwriting above.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board, compact and modern. Cascadia Mono would feel stiff if Delius Unicase were shrunk down to match it, so let the handwritten heading stay large.
